## Quality Assurance Checklist

Please verify that all the following criteria are met before requesting a review:

- [ ] **Tested Locally**: I have run the application locally and verified the changes work as expected.
- [ ] **Linter Passes**: I have run `npm run lint` in both `backend/` and `frontend/` folders and resolved all lint errors/warnings.
- [ ] **No Secrets Exposed**: I have verified that no `.env` files, credentials, or API keys are committed or exposed in this PR.
- [ ] **Task Linked**: This PR is linked to the corresponding task or issue.
- [ ] **Migrations/Database**: (If applicable) Database migrations are generated and tested locally.
- [ ] **Docker Containers**: (If applicable) Local container builds succeed and run without issues.
